summary: Frontend-only Airtel SCM Portal tested end-to-end via Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 19 BRD features in the review request are functional. Login (form + 5 demo cards), role-aware sidebar across 5 roles, header role-switcher + logout, KPIs on dashboard, multi-step Issue Submission with Similar-Issues dialog, Ticket Details (Comments/Audit/BRD tabs + Open BRD), COE Workbench (rows + priority/assign Select dropdowns), POC kanban with advance-task, BRD Editor (Approve/Reject toasts), SLA Monitor (4 tabs filter rows correctly — breached tab shows 1 of 8 rows), Validation screen (SCM-2025-12-000007 + accept/reject), Leadership dashboard (14 Recharts SVGs render without console errors), Admin Console (4 tabs), Notification Center (5 items + mark-all-read), Reports (filters + Export CSV toast). Logout returns to /login and clears localStorage session. No console errors detected. Session persists via localStorage key airtel_scm_auth_user as documented.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx pre-fills email/password with submitter credentials (ravi.kumar/demo123) — fine for a demo but should be cleared for any future non-demo build.
AuthContext useEffect writes to localStorage even on initial mount when user is null (calls removeItem). Harmless but slightly wasteful.
Sidebar role visibility relies on string equality of role name. Adding a new role string would silently hide items; consider a constant-based map.
IssueSubmission similar-issues matching is naive (first-word substring or module match). For a demo this is acceptable but flagged for completeness.
Header search input has no onChange handler — it is purely cosmetic. May confuse demo viewers; consider disabling or adding a no-op tooltip.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Pure frontend app with localStorage-based mock auth. No backend exists. Important data-testid patterns: nav-* (sidebar), header-user-menu-btn, switch-role-<role-kebab>, demo-user-<role-kebab>, login-* (login form), kpi-{open|breached|closed|savings}, workbench-row-*, priority-select-*, assign-select-*, kanban-col-*, kanban-card-*, advance-task-*, brd-approve-btn, brd-reject-btn, brd-section-*, sla-tab-*, sla-row-*, tab-{comments|audit|brd}, open-brd-btn (under BRD tab only), validation-accept-btn, validation-reject-btn, admin-tab-*, notif-item-*, notif-tab-*, mark-all-read-btn, export-csv-btn, form-* (issue submission), similar-issues-dialog, link-similar-<ticketId>, continue-new-btn, dismiss-similar-btn. Note: Open BRD button is rendered inside the BRD tab of TicketDetails — must click tab-brd first.
